links.comparator_used: Prompt chaining with guardrails but without FHIR schema validation (also compared against one-shot prompting and plain prompt chaining) on 40 simulated clinical vignettes
links.effect: The guardrail-plus-schema variant was reported as strongest; no numeric values are given in the abstract
links.quote: The guardrail-plus-schema variant achieved the strongest simulated safety and documentation consistency.
